method: Read-only UTF-8 file inspection; private-key, provider-token, JWT, authorization-value, authenticated-URL, SAS, named-secret and public-fixture patterns; high-entropy token triage; no external credential validation.
result: No credential material detected after publication redaction.
limits: Pattern and entropy checks cannot prove absence of every possible secret. No environment dumps, credential-store reads, live authentication or application execution were used. Source paths and ordinary credential-related terminology remain as evidence.
